Talent0_2Ability.name: Secret Execution
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Shotgun, inflict <buf ID=1004412>[Instability II]</buf> on the target before combat, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. This target cannot be affected by <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> during this combat.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Secret Execution
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When initiating combat with a Shotgun, inflicts <buf ID=1004412>[Instability II]</buf> on the target before combat. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. Lasts for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. The target cannot be affected by <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> during this skirmish.
When in combat with a target affected by <buf ID=900034>[Instability]</buf> stacks, gains Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color> per stack (up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>).

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700033.name: Shooting Cans
700033.SpecificEffects: In combat, if the Hit Rate is above <color=#F74848>80%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

201104.name: Coercion
201104.describe: Uses Shotgun to shoot a target <color=#F74848>2</color> times, with each shot dealing <color=#F74848>0.65x</color> DMG. After combat, it inflicts <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1004412>[Instability II]</buf> on the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

201107.name: Breakthrough Shot
201107.describe: Simultaneously use 2 Shotguns to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3*2 tile area in front</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>2* 0.6x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, it inflicts <buf ID=3008061>[Guard Disabled]</buf> on hit targets, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

201106.name: Load Raid
201106.describe: When an Arm suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking HP to <color=#F74848>1</color>. After an Active Attack, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, and move <color=#F74848>1</color> tile before attacking. These effects are unlimited and last until your next turn. Can continue to act after casting this skill.

201105.name: Charge Up
201105.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, if the total hits are <color=#F74848>12</color> or more, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

201108.name: Brutal Shooting
201108.describe: Simultaneously uses 2 Shotguns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2*0.75x</color> DMG. This attack ignores the target's Armor status.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

201141.name: High Pressure Oscillation 1
201141.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Shotgun, if the target is within an adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area, knock it back <color=#F74848>1</color> tile after combat.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

201144.name: High Pressure Oscillation 2
201144.SpecificEffects: When knocking back the target, if the path is blocked, inflict <buf ID=2011442>[Intimidation]</buf> on the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

201145.name: High Pressure Vibration 3
201145.SpecificEffects: When using a Shotgun for an Active Attack on a target within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area, increase damage to the Body part by <color=#F74848>35%</color>.

201146.name: High Pressure Oscillation 4
201146.SpecificEffects: When knocking back the target, if the path is blocked, additionally deal <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> once for <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG to the target.
